title: Pattern evaluation
description: Immutable derived result of evaluating one evaluation request (design decisions ADR-006, ADR-017). It is never an artifact revision. The full request is embedded verbatim. Conditions enforced by this schema: 'status' = 'succeeded' requires 'constraintStatus' = 'solved' and 'snapshotRef'; 'status' = 'failed' forbids 'snapshotRef'. Producers emit 'inputDigests' and 'diagnostics' in the canonical array order of digest profile d2p-digest-v1.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a pattern evaluation.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: UTC time the evaluation was produced. Excluded from 'resultDigest'.

request.description: The complete evaluation request document, embedded verbatim with its own header. Its 'schemaVersion' must equal the 'schemaVersion' of this document (D2P-STR-003).

evaluator.description: Engine, version, algorithm profile and evaluator profile that produced this result.

featureSetVersion.description: Version of the 'd2p:' feature types and expression nodes in use: the release version that introduced the feature set.

inputDigests.description: Digests of all pinned inputs. At least one entry with role 'pattern' is mandatory.

constraintStatus.description: Status of the constraint system. A pattern without constraints is 'solved'.

snapshotRef.description: Reference to the geometry snapshot produced by this evaluation. Present if and only if 'status' = 'succeeded'. 'digest' is required and equals the snapshot's 'geometryDigest'.

measurements.description: Measured garment values. With requested output 'measurement-report' and a garment measurement specification: one entry per applicable target, keyed by the target 'id'; otherwise empty ([]). Sorted by 'key'.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics reported during the evaluation (may be empty).

resultDigest.description: Digest of this document excluding 'contentDigest', 'resultDigest', 'evaluationId' and every top-level member ending in 'At' (digest profile d2p-digest-v1).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

constraintStatus.title: Constraint status
constraintStatus.description: Status of a constraint system. Mapping of common solver vocabularies: unique solution → 'solved', timeout → 'nonconvergent'; a generic failure is reported as evaluation status 'failed' plus the closest status and a diagnostic, never as 'solved'.

evaluationMeasurement.title: Evaluation measurement
evaluationMeasurement.description: One measured garment value of an evaluation, in canonical units.

key.description: Key of the measurement: the 'id' of the garment measurement target it answers.

definitionId.description: Measurement definition the value is measured by.

unit.description: Canonical unit of 'value': 'mm' for lengths, 'rad' for angles.
